purpose: Non-admission discovery of Singapore original company-register, insurance regulator and ILS financial-source products with legal identity, historic claims and model-provenance constraints.

entries.name: Singapore ACRA registered-entities government open-data snapshot
entries.provider: Accounting and Corporate Regulatory Authority (ACRA), Singapore
entries.spatial_scope: Singapore legal companies including insurance and special-purpose reinsurance entities
entries.temporal_scope: Monthly government dataset last updated 2026-10-14; coverage ending 2026-10-11
entries.resolution_or_granularity: Exact company name, UEN, issuing agency, registration status, entity type, UEN issue date and street; four SPRV identifiers independently checked
entries.note: Original ACRA issuer and four exact UEN matches are checked and original JSON response SHA256 receipts are recorded. This dated public dataset is not a certified live Bizfile registry extract. Company registration does not establish a GLEIF LEI, licensed insurer portfolio, equity ownership or geolocated insured asset.

entries.name: MAS Singapore Financial Institutions Directory special-purpose reinsurance vehicles
entries.spatial_scope: Licensed Singapore special-purpose reinsurance vehicles and service managers
entries.temporal_scope: Live official regulator directory viewed 2026-11-04; original page version must be independently archived
entries.resolution_or_granularity: Institution name, regulator institution code, permitted reinsurance category and named operating manager; Astro RA16G, Manatee RA03G, Nakama RA18G and Tomoni RA21G
entries.note: Distinct from separately registered MAS annual company financial returns. A MAS-listed operating manager such as Marsh or Aon is not automatically a cedant, contract issuer, ultimate legal parent, equity owner or holder of insured risk. No complete customer or policy book is present.

entries.name: Signed audited Manatee Re III FY2024 and Hurricane Ida public claim observation
entries.provider: Manatee Re III Pte. Ltd., signed accounts hosted by Bermuda Stock Exchange
entries.spatial_scope: Singapore special-purpose reinsurer with one disclosed United States Hurricane Ida 2021 reinsurance loss
entries.temporal_scope: Fiscal year ended 2024-12-31 with 2023 comparative; directors signed 2025-04-29
entries.resolution_or_granularity: Audited company notes identify Manatee Shares Trust ownership role, Safepoint Hurricane Ida Class A estimate, cumulative paid and remaining reserve, plus principal-at-risk notes
entries.note: Original note 4 reports two-year exact paid-plus-reserve identities for one Ida event. Printed 28.57 percent is rounded and cannot be promoted as confirmed contract share; historical settlement is not complete policy wording, vendor event loss, insured TIV, retro settlement, FRS117 liability bridge or a CAT risk calibration.
